title: How do Governance Planes classify claims within an artifact?
question: How do Governance Planes classify claims within an artifact?
answer: BPR-3: Planes classify claims, not whole ADRs. In an accepted, non-superseded ADR the active decision claim is architectural Canon; rationale and alternatives usually give Grounding; provenance and history may give Enduring Context. A proposed ADR holds no Canon. A superseded ADR keeps historical context while its explicit successor carries active Canon.
